reasons.plausibility: Using ultrafast pulsed laser processing to reduce heat input and mitigate thermal stresses in miniature AlCrFeNiSi parts is scientifically reasonable, though some uncertainties remain in scaling and process control.
reasons.testability: The A–B comparison with conventional processing and direct measurements of stresses, microstructure, and mechanical properties provides a clear test that can falsify or support the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This intervention precisely addresses the challenge of minimizing thermal stresses and improving mechanical properties in high-entropy alloy AM, making it directly relevant and valuable.
